text: Lactoferrin is a small fraction of milk protein, so it is fished out of the flow with a cation-exchange column and eluted with salt. Membrane filtration and salt extraction are also used.

steps.note: On a strong cation exchanger (S Sepharose Fast Flow, Mono S in the patent).

steps.name: elute
steps.note: With NaCl, stepwise or gradient; bovine lactoferrin comes off at about 0.75 M (patent: loaded at 0.4 M, gradient 0.4–1.0 M).
